subject: Request: Temporary SLA adjustment for Labor Day holiday window
messages:
From: Priya Menon <ops@citybank.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: it-lead@citybank.com, procure@citybank.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SLA adjustment for Labor Day holiday window

Hi Neha,

Quick context: CityBank will have a distributed ops/engineering skeleton crew for Labor Day (Sep 4-6). Several of our on-call engineers will be on-site for customer-facing obligations and we anticipate limited ability to engage in immediate multi-team escalations overnight (00:00-08:00 ET).

We rely on Redwood's P1/P2 response SLAs. For this upcoming holiday window we want to request a temporary, limited exception:
- Keep P1 (platform-down, customer-impacting) response expectations as-is (30 min initial response).
- Temporarily extend P2 (partial degradation / non-critical failures) initial response from 4 hours to 8 hours during the overnight block (00:00-08:00 ET) only from Sep 4 00:00 ET through Sep 6 08:00 ET.
- We will accept a reduced second-tier on-call (no dedicated on-site second-tier engineer overnight) if Redwood can commit to a clearly documented escalation matrix and a named on-call escalation contact for P1/P2 during the window.

Two asks from our side:
1) Please confirm whether Redwood can agree to the temporary P2 initial response expansion and provide an escalation contact (name & mobile).
2) Share any temporary runbook changes or on-call rota you plan to put in place so we can align on expectations (e.g., when to open an incident vs. when to wait for the extended window).

We understand this is an exception and are open to a written addendum. We want to avoid surprises for our customers and would like confirmation by COB tomorrow (Aug 21) so we can update internal comms.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Head of Platform Ops, CityBank
ops@citybank.com
Attachment: proposed_citybank_window.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: it-lead@citybank.com, ops@citybank.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA adjustment for Labor Day holiday window

Team — forwarding CityBank's request (see below). TL;DR they want a temporary P2 response expansion (4h -> 8h) overnight for Sep 4-6 and a clear escalation contact. They explicitly want P1 unchanged.

Proposed plan (please comment / sign off by EOD tomorrow):
- Approve a timeboxed exception for P2 initial response: 00:00-08:00 ET, Sep 4 00:00 ET through Sep 6 08:00 ET. We will not change P1.
- Provide a named escalation contact for P1 (on-call lead: Vivek Kulkarni mobile listed below) and a backup (Marissa).
- Publish a temporary runbook addendum and the on-call rota; attach the rota and escalation matrix for review.
- Draft a one-page addendum (legal / procurement) that documents the window, the change, and that no credit will be due for P2 extended response (unless P1 breach occurs). Jordan, please confirm if procurement needs different language for the addendum.
- Ops: add monitoring alert thresholds for the window so we can be proactive and avoid P2s where possible.

If anyone objects to approving this as a limited, written exception, please call out specifics. If no objections, I'll reply to Priya and copy the escalation contacts and attach the draft addendum and rota.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: holiday_oncall_rota.xlsx (Excel, 18KB), escalation_matrix.pdf (PDF, 24KB), temp_sla_addendum_draft.docx (DOCX, 14KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA adjustment for Labor Day holiday window

Neha / all,

I support granting a limited exception for P2 overnight as long as we put these mitigations in place:
- Add a short, explicit P1 escalation contact list in the escalation_matrix.pdf with mobile numbers (I will be primary for P1; Marissa backup). I will set up a dedicated pager rule for the window.
- Temporary automatic fallbacks: pin customers to a conservative model variant for the overnight block to reduce noise.
- Enable higher-sensitivity alerting for request error rate and latency thresholds 24 hours before the window begins (to proactively detect regressions).
- Ensure our on-call rotation spreadsheet includes the backup contact and timezones (I've updated holiday_oncall_rota.xlsx).

On legal: I'm fine with the draft addendum that says P2 initial response is extended and that SLA credits are not triggered by P2 during this narrow window. Jordan / Procurement should confirm language.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Infrastructure & Reliability, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1-415-555-0172
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ops@citybank.com, it-lead@citybank.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA adjustment for Labor Day holiday window — APPROVED (timeboxed)

Priya / Carlos — thanks for the heads up. We reviewed internally and approve a timeboxed exception as requested. Summary of agreement: 
- Window: Sep 4 00:00 ET through Sep 6 08:00 ET.
- P1: No change (30 min initial response).
- P2: Initial response extended from 4h -> 8h during overnight block only (00:00-08:00 ET) for the window above.
- On-call: Vivek Kulkarni (primary P1) and Marissa Cole (backup) will be the named escalation contacts for P1. Contact details in the attached escalation_matrix.pdf.
- Runbook / monitoring: We'll publish a temporary runbook addendum and enable elevated alerts 24 hours before the window.
- Legal: We will provide a short addendum document that both parties can sign; it will state the exception is timeboxed and does not create a recurring SLA change.

Next steps:
1) Neha / Marissa to attach final addendum and escalation matrix to this thread.
2) CityBank to confirm acceptance of the addendum and provide a counter-signature by EOD Aug 24.
3) Implementation: Redwood ops to enable elevated alerts on Sep 3 and publish the temporary runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping things smooth over the holiday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
